expectations.text: Recommends one consistent error shape reused across both REST responses and webhooks
expectations.evidence: Defines one canonical `error` object reused in REST body and nested unchanged in the webhook event.

expectations.text: Uses the `issues` array with `severity` to distinguish errors vs warnings
expectations.evidence: Single `error` object (RFC 9457-style) with `retryable`/`status`; no `issues` array and no `severity`, so warnings can't ride alongside.
`extractError`, `apiFetch`, `ErrorBanner`, and an SSE hook for webhook-driven errors.

expectations.text: Notes consumers should tolerate unknown issue codes
expectations.evidence: Uses a closed `ERROR_CATALOG` enum (`satisfies Record<...>`); no guidance to tolerate unknown codes.
